Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class FavouriteStore

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.FavouriteStore
public class FavouriteStore extends Object
Favourites (Buyer to Listing) and Follows (Buyer to Seller) associations, both many-to-many with no duplicates (SRS class diagram, UC-1.3 S1). Lists keep the order in which items were added. Keys are lower-cased usernames, matching UserStore. Every toggle is saved to the favourites / follows tables; load() rebuilds them at startup.
